description: Details required by condition 6 (FRA, SuDS) of planning permission PP/26/00206 (Provision of basement beneath the building, modification of western lightwell to provide lowered windows at lower ground floor level and access stair to garden level, replacement of existing lower ground floor extension to eastern lightwell and modifications to balustrade and railings around the lightwell; provision of a bay window to the southern elevation with balustrade above, relocation of front door and provision of a portico, provision of new windows to rear elevation, replacement of all windows with double glazed units, replacement of front boundary railings to match the detail of neighbouring buildings, provision of rooflights at main roof level, and provision of 1no. ASHP and 2no. condenser units at main roof level below the parapet line)
